name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Stand about two feet in front of a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Place the top of your rear foot on the bench behind you. Your front foot carries the work; the back leg is only for balance.
Keeping your torso upright, bend your front knee and lower until your front thigh is roughly parallel to the floor.
Drive through the whole of your front foot to stand back up, without pushing off the rear leg.
Finish all your reps on one leg before swapping sides.

name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
instructions: Kneel on a pad with your ankles anchored under a secure bar, or held down by a partner.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs so your body makes a straight line from knees to shoulders.
Lower your torso toward the floor as slowly as you can, resisting the whole way with your hamstrings.
Catch yourself with your hands when you can no longer control the descent.
Push off the floor just enough to get back to the start, then begin the next rep.

name: Copenhagen Plank
instructions: Lie on your side and set your forearm under your shoulder as you would for a side plank.
Rest the inside of your top leg on a bench, near the knee to start with and nearer the ankle as you get stronger.
Press down into the bench with the top leg and lift your hips until your body is in a straight line.
Let the bottom leg hang, or tuck it under the bench.
Hold, then lower under control and swap sides.

name: Bird Dog
instructions: Start on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and your knees under your hips.
Brace your abs so your lower back stays flat, not arched or rounded.
Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg straight back until both are level with your torso.
Hold, keeping your hips square to the floor — do not let one side rotate up.
Return under control and repeat on the other side.

name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
instructions: Set an incline bench to roughly 45 degrees and lie chest-down on it with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight down and your shoulder blades spread apart.
Pull the dumbbells toward your hips, leading with your elbows and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause briefly at the top without letting your chest come off the bench.
Lower the weights all the way back down under control.

name: Pendlay Row
instructions: Set a barbell on the floor and stand over it with your feet about hip-width apart.
Hinge at the hips until your torso is parallel to the floor, and take an overhand grip just outside your knees.
Brace hard and pull the bar explosively into your lower chest, keeping your torso still.
Return the bar all the way to the floor and let it settle between reps.
Reset your back position before every rep — this lift starts dead each time.

name: Burpee
instructions: Stand tall with your feet about shoulder-width apart.
Squat down and place your hands on the floor in front of your feet.
Jump or step your feet back into a push-up position, keeping your hips level with your shoulders.
Lower your chest to the floor for a push-up, then press back up.
Jump or step your feet back in toward your hands, then stand and jump straight up with your arms overhead.

name: Wall Sit
instructions: Stand with your back flat against a wall and walk your feet out about two feet.
Slide down the wall until your knees are bent to about 90 degrees and your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Keep your whole back against the wall and your weight in your heels.
Hold the position and breathe normally rather than holding your breath.
Walk your feet back in and stand up when the hold is finished.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
instructions: Kneel on a pad and hold an ab wheel on the floor directly under your shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes and tuck your ribs down so your lower back is flat.
Roll the wheel forward, letting your body extend, and go only as far as you can without your hips sagging.
Pull the wheel back in by bracing your abs — not by sitting back onto your heels.
Stop the set the moment your lower back starts to arch.

name: Hollow Body Hold
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms overhead and your legs straight.
Press your lower back flat into the floor and keep it there for the whole hold.
Lift your shoulder blades and your legs a few inches off the floor.
Lower your arms and legs only as far as you can while keeping your back flat.
Hold, then bend your knees and set everything down when the position starts to break.

name: Suitcase Carry
instructions: Stand a heavy dumbbell or kettlebell beside one foot and pick it up with a flat back.
Stand tall with the weight hanging at one side and your shoulders level.
Walk in a straight line, resisting the pull that wants to bend you toward the weight.
Keep your ribs down and your steps even rather than rushing.
Set the weight down with a flat back, then repeat carrying on the other side.

name: Cossack Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet much wider than shoulder-width, toes pointing slightly out.
Shift your weight over one leg and sit down into that hip, bending that knee.
Let the other leg straighten out to the side with the toes coming off the floor.
Go as low as your hips allow with your heel staying down, then push back to the middle.
Repeat to the other side, alternating for the set.

name: Dead Hang
instructions: Take an overhand grip on a pull-up bar, about shoulder-width apart.
Step or jump off and let your body hang with your arms straight.
Keep your shoulders active rather than shrugged up into your ears.
Relax your legs and breathe, letting your spine decompress.
Step down under control rather than dropping off the bar.

name: Couch Stretch
instructions: Kneel in front of a wall or the base of a bench with a pad under your knee.
Slide one knee back so the shin runs up the wall and the top of that foot rests against it.
Bring the other foot forward and flat on the floor in a half-kneeling position.
Squeeze the glute of the back leg and bring your torso upright until you feel a stretch down the front of the hip and thigh.
Breathe and hold, then swap sides.

name: 90/90 Hip Switch
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg bent in front of you at 90 degrees and the other bent out to the side at 90 degrees.
Sit up tall with your hands on the floor behind you for support.
Keeping your feet where they are, rotate both knees over to the other side and let them settle on the floor.
Pause for a second in each position rather than rushing the switch.
Keep alternating sides for the set.

name: Reverse Nordic Curl
instructions: Kneel on a pad with your knees about hip-width apart and your feet flat behind you.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs so your hips stay straight, not bent.
Lean your whole body backward from the knees, keeping the line from knees to shoulders.
Go only as far as you can control, then pull yourself back up with your quads.
Stop the set as soon as your hips start bending to help you.

name: Air Bike Intervals
instructions: Set the seat so your leg is almost straight at the bottom of the pedal stroke.
Take the handles and start pedalling easily for two to three minutes to warm up.
Sprint hard, pushing and pulling the handles as well as driving the pedals, for 20 to 30 seconds.
Pedal slowly for 60 to 90 seconds to recover.
Repeat for six to ten rounds, then cool down easy for a few minutes.
